sources: May 1796: Edward Jenner inoculated 8-year-old James Phipps with matter from a cowpox sore of milkmaid Sarah Nelmes; July 1796 he exposed him to smallpox; Phipps stayed healthy. WHO, 'History of smallpox vaccination'.

Smallpox killed about 3 in 10 people infected (NIAID via Live Science); vaccination from Latin vacca = cow (Pfizer, 'Smallpox vanquished'); declared eradicated in 1980, the only human disease eradicated so far (WHO; Our World in Data).
